Yes, that's what the guarantee provides, as long as your claim is approved. I can't promise approval myself because a Plant Care Specialist makes that decision. But losing almost half its leaves is well past the "more than a third" mark for significant decline, so your case fits the criteria.

**If your claim is approved:**
- You get **one free replacement of the same plant**, a bird of paradise.
- If that plant is out of stock, you get **store credit** instead.
- You don't need to send the sick plant back.
- The replacement comes with its own **new 30-day guarantee**, from its delivery date.

I don't have a shipping timeframe for replacements, so I can't give you a date. I'd rather say that than guess. The Support Lead can tell you more when they follow up on your claim.

My offer of a one-time **$15 store credit** for the delay is still open if you'd like it. Just say the word.

Thanks for your patience through all of this. Please reach out any time. 🌿
